body:

[browny3196] Not a deal my guy. This drops to $50ish regularly.
[BestTechAdvisor] Every time I check Amazon lately it's either not in stock or is near RRP.
[browny3196] Between Amazon, Woolies, Coles and Costco, it's fine. Amazon does have long dry spells without sales though yes.
[BestTechAdvisor] Will also be $8.75 for a 4 pack from Coles as of tomorrow.
[Jimothy Wongingtons] I got 10 x 4 packs over the last few days at Woolies, loaded up at 8.25 / pack🚀🚀
[amyls] Check Coles for the 9 packs in the bulk buys section, on clearance for $9.90.
[browny3196] Dude is editing this post like its going out of fashion @Kazusa
[blitzn] Aldi has 2 new flavours which ive been going for now $1.99 each, mango and peach, just as good as monster when its not on sale.
[Jimothy Wongingtons] I haven’t seen mango for some months now at my two local stores… was buying 10-15 cans some weeks
[blitzn] 1 was selling them and then stopped now the other is selling.
Also try limit to 1 can a day max, i had a friend who died at 39 years old from a heart attack who used to drink 3 to 4 a day.
[Raptors] Damn 39 is way too young!!! Sorry to hear that. Did he have other health issues? Like was he very overweight etc? I'm 46 and I have been having 2 a day, every day for the last 5 years or so. Or on training days (4 days a week) I limit to 1 as I have 1 scoop of pre workout before the gym which is usually 200 - 250mg caffeine, so with the 160mg in the energy drink it comes out to 360 - 410mg total.
